title: Контраст и порядок аргументов
description: Контраст и порядок аргументов: разбираем конструкцию и её смысл на примерах, в диалоге и авторском тексте без аудирования.
objectives: Отличать ограничение по срокам от отказа от предложения
notes: Вынос дополнения в начало может создать контраст: The cost we could absorb; the delay we could not.
Такой вынос не требует автоматической инверсии; отрицательная инверсия — отдельная конструкция.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: Choose neutral contrastive fronting: “The financial cost ___; the delay we could not.”
exercises.explanation: При выносе объекта the financial cost сохраняется we could absorb.

exercises.prompt: Вставь подходящее слово из пары: could / must to.

public_payload.sentence: The budget we could revise; the legal deadline we ___ not change.

exercises.editorial_answer: The budget we could revise; the legal deadline we could not change.
exercises.explanation: Модальный could с not change обозначает отсутствие возможности изменить срок.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Расходы мы могли взять на себя, а задержку — нет.»
exercises.editorial_answer: The cost we could absorb; the delay we could not.
exercises.explanation: Два вынесенных объекта противопоставляют приемлемую и неприемлемую стороны решения.

exercises.prompt: Исправь только ошибку в конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The revised budget could we accept; the revised deadline we could not.

accepted: The revised budget we could accept; the revised deadline we could not.

exercises.reference_answer: The revised budget we could accept; the revised deadline we could not.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The revised budget could we accept; the revised deadline we could not.
exercises.editorial_answer: The revised budget we could accept; the revised deadline we could not.
exercises.explanation: В заданном контрастивном выносе объекта нет основания для could we.

exercises.prompt: Какую функцию выполняет контраст в цитате?

public_payload.passage: A transport charity considered replacing its booking software midway through a busy season. The new system promised lower running costs, but migration would require a week without online bookings. In the board discussion, the treasurer said, “The additional training cost we could absorb; the interruption to service we could not.” This was not a rejection of the software’s long-term value. It distinguished a manageable expense from a short-term constraint that conflicted with the charity’s obligations. The board postponed migration until winter, when telephone demand was lower. Its minutes recorded a decision about timing and feasibility, rather than a conclusion that the proposed system was intrinsically unsuitable.

options.label: It separates an affordable cost from an unacceptable interruption.
It claims that all costs and delays are equally manageable.
It reverses the charity’s obligation to provide a service.

exercises.editorial_answer: It separates an affordable cost from an unacceptable interruption.
exercises.explanation: Вынос training cost и interruption подчёркивает разные оценки этих факторов.

exercises.prompt: Что было решено о самом программном обеспечении?

public_payload.passage: A transport charity considered replacing its booking software midway through a busy season. The new system promised lower running costs, but migration would require a week without online bookings. In the board discussion, the treasurer said, “The additional training cost we could absorb; the interruption to service we could not.” This was not a rejection of the software’s long-term value. It distinguished a manageable expense from a short-term constraint that conflicted with the charity’s obligations. The board postponed migration until winter, when telephone demand was lower. Its minutes recorded a decision about timing and feasibility, rather than a conclusion that the proposed system was intrinsically unsuitable.

options.label: It was judged intrinsically unsuitable in every season.
It was installed immediately without interruption.
Its long-term value was not rejected; migration was postponed.

exercises.editorial_answer: Its long-term value was not rejected; migration was postponed.
exercises.explanation: Решение касалось сроков и осуществимости перехода, а не полного отказа.

exercises.prompt: Сохрани контраст между идеей и сроками.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Does “The proposal we welcomed; the timetable we questioned” reject everything?

options.label: No; it accepts the proposal while challenging the timetable.
Yes; both parts must express rejection.
No; it guarantees approval of every later revision.

exercises.editorial_answer: No; it accepts the proposal while challenging the timetable.
exercises.explanation: Welcomed и questioned имеют разные объекты; общее одобрение всех будущих изменений не следует.

public_payload.sentence: Balancing lower cost against a slower service involves a ___.

exercises.explanation: Trade-off — выбор между конкурирующими преимуществами и недостатками.
